description: This file implements a handler module for integrating with the Codestral text completion API. It includes classes for managing errors, making API calls (both synchronous and asynchronous), parsing responses, and handling environment validation and logging. The main class, CodestralTextCompletion, provides methods for performing text completions with support for streaming, custom prompts, and environment configuration.
